Daily context adds stress, sleep and useful notes. If there were no symptoms, explicitly confirm this in the daily review. A day with entries but no completed review is unfinished: its recorded events remain in the diary, but missing foods or symptoms cannot reliably be treated as absent. Diary entries remain locally until you edit or delete them, reset the diary, or remove the app's stored files. My space provides export, backup and diary-deletion controls. Starting a fresh diary after a storage error preserves the older unreadable database so it is not overwritten. Deleting the active diary does not delete separately preserved files, operating-system backups, exports or copies you have shared. Bellywise cannot recover records from a developer server because no diary server exists.

The native app uses a SQLCipher-encrypted database. A random encryption key is held in the device's secure key store and is available only while the device is unlocked. It is configured to remain on that device. Encryption depends on your device's security, passcode and operating-system protections; it is not a guarantee against access to an unlocked or compromised device.
